<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Vicissitude Private Reserve</title>
<meta name="theme-color" content="#050505">
<style>
:root{--ivory:#efe8db;--brass:#c49a54;--muted:#998e7f;--line:#2d241a}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:#050505;color:var(--ivory);font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif}
button,a{font:inherit} .hidden{display:none!important}

#entrance{
  height:100svh;
  min-height:640px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  overflow:hidden;
  background:#000;
}
.panel{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-width:0}
.panel img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.left img{object-position:center center}
.center img{object-position:center center}
.right img{object-position:center center}

.hotspot{
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;
  top:84.4%;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:48%;
  height:9.4%;
  border:0;
  background:transparent;
  border-radius:999px;
  cursor:pointer;
  z-index:3;
}
.hotspot:hover,.hotspot:focus-visible{
  outline:none;
  box-shadow:0 0 18px 7px rgba(205,149,67,.18);
}

#reserve{
  display:none;
  min-height:100svh;
  max-width:1180px;
  margin:auto;
  padding:48px 22px 84px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%,rgba(148,92,27,.12),transparent 34%),#050505;
}
#reserve.active{display:block}
.back{display:block;margin:0 auto 38px;background:transparent;color:#938879;border:1px solid #3a3024;padding:10px 18px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.72rem;cursor:pointer}
.back:hover,.back:focus-visible{color:#efe8db;border-color:var(--brass);outline:none}
.head{text-align:center;max-width:720px;margin:0 auto 46px}
.eyebrow{color:#a88c60;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.72rem}
.head h1{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,5vw,4.4rem);font-weight:400;margin:10px 0 14px}
.head p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.72}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px}
.card{min-height:315px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:28px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#14110e,#0d0c0b);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end}
.card small{color:var(--brass);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.7rem}
.card h2{font-size:1.9rem;font-weight:400;margin:11px 0}
.card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.67}
.card a{margin-top:20px;color:var(--ivory);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--brass);width:max-content;padding-bottom:4px}
.footer{text-align:center;color:#6d6458;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.11em;margin-top:62px}

@media(max-width:820px){
  #entrance{display:block;height:100svh;min-height:0}
  .left,.right{display:none}
  .center{height:100svh}
  .center img{object-fit:cover;object-position:center}
  .hotspot{top:84.4%;width:48%;height:9.4%}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<section id="entrance" aria-label="Vicissitude Private Reserve entrance">
  <div class="panel left"><img src="data:image/avif;base64,
